market.title: Will GTA 6 Be Released in 2026?
resolutionNote: Kalshi's own wording: "If GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) has been released on a major platform (PS5, Xbox Series X/S, Windows) by Dec 31, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes."
Rockstar's own confirmed release date, November 19, 2026, already sits comfortably inside this window - the market is really pricing the risk of a third delay pushing the game into 2027.

No direct Polymarket equivalent exists for this specific window. The closest Polymarket contract asks the inverse question - 'GTA 6 launch postponed again?', resolving by Nov 19, 2026 - rather than a same-scale 'released by' market, so it isn't tracked on this page.

text: GTA 6 has already been delayed twice - originally targeted for 2025, then pushed to May 2026, and now to November 19, 2026 - so Kalshi prices "released in 2026" at a still-high but not certain 85-87%.

Rockstar paired the latest delay announcement in November 2025 with a rare direct apology to fans, saying the extra time would let them "finish the game with the level of polish you have come to expect and deserve."
Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick has since repeatedly reaffirmed the date, telling investors in July 2026 he has a "high degree of confidence" in the November 19 release.

The remaining risk priced in by traders is a third delay - Zelnick has himself noted the studio would rather push the date again than ship early, since "when our competitors go to market before something was ready, bad things happen."
